# Communications provider artwork

Original SVGs retrieved from official provider sites on **2026-10-21**. The [manifest](manifest.json) records sources, original byte counts and SHA-256 hashes. Artwork is unchanged: no generation, tracing, recoloring, cropping or path edits by Aureform. The neutral white plate retains each supplied aspect ratio.

| Provider | Original source                                                                                                                                                                                          | Brand conditions                                                                                                                                                          |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Twilio   | [Official monochrome site icon](https://www.twilio.com/content/dam/twilio-com/core-assets/social/safari-pinned-tab.svg)                                                                                  | [Trademark guidelines](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/legal/trademark): corporate-logo use requires express written permission. This package does not establish permission. |
| Telnyx   | [Official black horizontal wordmark](https://dila2qpfw3s64.cloudfront.net/_next/static/media/telnyx-logo-text.3ol7qfk480jrf.svg?dpl=1dfe2a0) linked by the [official site](https://telnyx.com/media-kit) | [Media-kit guidance](https://telnyx.com/media-kit): preserve the logo and clearspace; use black on light backgrounds.                                                     |

Twilio and all related logos are trademarks of Twilio Inc. or its affiliates. Telnyx and its logo are trademarks of Telnyx LLC.

These third-party marks are **excluded from Aureform's Apache-2.0 grant**. Their inclusion does not imply affiliation, endorsement, an account connection or tested telephony. Consumers must retain these notices and establish the permission required for their use.

This separate communications catalog leaves the existing integration identities, mappings and assets unchanged.
